name: activate_kms_signing_key
description:
Activate a pending signing key so the issuer starts signing with it.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys/{keyId}/activate --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

keyId.description: The ID of the pending signing key to activate.

revokePreviousAfterHours.description: How many hours after activation the previously-active key should stop being used. Defaults to a 1 hour grace period so already-issued tokens keep verifying.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
